nodes.description: Caller address provided by the transaction; used as depositor/withdrawer, governance check and transfer recipient.
External nonReentrant deposit function that pulls acceptToken from the caller and mints shares.
External nonReentrant withdraw function that burns shares and returns acceptToken to the caller.
External nonReentrant entry point that claims accrued STACK rewards for msg.sender.
Internal reward accounting routine that kicks emission, updates user's accrued tokens and transfers STACK.
Internal emission accumulator that updates tokensAccrued and lastBlock based on elapsed blocks.
External nonReentrant governance-only rescue that transfers stuck tokens or ETH to governance.
External function allowing current governance to change the governance address.
External governance-only function that kicks current accrual and updates the emission rate.
External governance-only function that extends the distribution end block within limits.
Governance address (STACK DAO Council multisig) controlling admin functions and rescue.
STACK tokens emitted per block used to compute reward accrual.
Total shares currently deposited in the gauge.
Block at which the distribution ends.
Last block at which the emission distribution was run.
Global reward accumulator per unit of weight scaled by 1e18.
Mapping of user address to DepositState (userShares and tokensAccrued).
Immutable STACK DAO reward token address distributed by the gauge.
Immutable shares-based rebase token (WBTC stack token) accepted for deposits.
External ERC20 transferFrom call pulling acceptToken from the depositor into the gauge.
External ERC20 transfer sending acceptToken back to the withdrawing user.
External ERC20 transfer sending accrued STACK tokens to the claiming user.
Native ETH transfer to governance in rescue when token address is zero.
External ERC20 transfer sending a stuck token from the gauge to governance.
Amount of acceptToken the caller wishes to deposit.
Amount of acceptToken the caller wishes to withdraw.
User address passed to _claimSTACK whose rewards are being settled.
Number of elapsed blocks used to compute accrued emissions in _kick.
Tokens to accrue for the current delta block window in _kick.
Amount of STACK tokens to give the user in _claimSTACK.

edges.reason: deposit calls _claimSTACK to settle pending rewards for the depositor before pulling funds.
msg.sender is passed as the _user argument to _claimSTACK, so rewards are settled for the caller.
deposit performs an external token transferFrom on acceptToken controlled by an external contract.
msg.sender is the source address of the tokens pulled by safeTransferFrom in deposit.
acceptToken is the ERC20 token targeted by the safeTransferFrom call in deposit.
the _amount parameter determines the value transferred by safeTransferFrom in deposit.
deposit updates depositedShares with the shares computed from the deposited amount.
deposit reads and writes the shares mapping entry for the depositor.
the _amount parameter drives share computation and the emitted Deposit/Transfer events.
withdraw calls _claimSTACK to settle pending rewards before burning shares.
withdraw performs an external token transfer of acceptToken to the caller.
msg.sender is the recipient of the safeTransfer call in withdraw.
acceptToken is the ERC20 token target of the safeTransfer call in withdraw.
withdraw reads and updates the shares mapping entry, subtracting user shares.
withdraw decreases the global depositedShares counter.
claimSTACK delegates all work to the internal _claimSTACK routine.
claimSTACK claims rewards for msg.sender.
_claimSTACK calls _kick to bring the global emission accumulator up to date.
_claimSTACK performs an external STACK transfer to the user after updating state.
the user address (traceable to msg.sender) is the recipient of the STACK safeTransfer.
STACK is the reward token transferred by _claimSTACK.
the _user parameter selects which share entry is settled in _claimSTACK.
_claimSTACK reads and writes the shares mapping entry for the user.
_claimSTACK computes the accrued token difference from the global tokensAccrued accumulator.
the _tokensGive local amount determines the value of the STACK safeTransfer.
_kick reads depositedShares as the total weight used to normalize emissions.
_kick updates the global tokensAccrued accumulator with newly accrued emissions.
emissionRate multiplies the delta blocks to compute tokens to accrue in _kick.
_kick stores block.number into lastBlock after accrual.
endBlock bounds the delta block calculation inside _kick.
the _deltaBlock local is the elapsed-block value used for emission computation.
the _tokensToAccrue local is added into the tokensAccrued accumulator.
rescue performs a native ETH transfer to governance when the token address is zero.
rescue performs an external token transfer to governance.
governance is the recipient of the rescued token via safeTransfer.
rescue requires msg.sender to equal governance before transferring funds.
msg.sender is checked against governance in rescue.
setGovernance writes the new governance address into the governance state variable.
setGovernance requires msg.sender to equal the current governance.
setEmissionRate calls _kick to catch up accrual at the old rate before changing it.
setEmissionRate overwrites the emissionRate state variable.
setEmissionRate requires msg.sender to equal governance.
setEndBlock writes the new endBlock value.
setEndBlock requires msg.sender to equal governance.

normalization_plan.reason: The deposit amount parameter only feeds share computation and the token pull inside deposit, so it is folded into deposit.
The withdraw amount parameter only feeds share burn computation and the token transfer inside withdraw, so it is folded into withdraw.
The _user parameter only selects the share entry settled inside _claimSTACK, so it is folded into _claimSTACK.
The _deltaBlock local only exists to compute emissions inside _kick, so it is folded into _kick.
The _tokensToAccrue local is only used to update tokensAccrued inside _kick, so it is folded into _kick.
The _tokensGive local only determines the STACK transfer amount inside _claimSTACK, so it is folded into _claimSTACK.
